info.title: Interzoid Get Global Time API
info.description: This API retrieves the current time for a city or geographic location around the globe.

get.summary: Gets the current time for a global locale
get.description: Gets the current time for a global locale (city, state, region, or country such as Chicago, London, Paris, Seoul, Spain, Buenos Aires, Hawaii, Moscow, Tokyo, Hanoi, etc.)

parameters.name: license
parameters.description: Your Interzoid license API key. Register at www.interzoid.com/register

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Geographic locale to get the current time for

200.description: Current global time in many forms and related information
